story_type: missing boaters clinging to a capsized hull
hook: Two missing men, clinging to a capsized hull
narration: Two missing men were found clinging to the hull of their capsized boat.
They had gone out on a weekend fishing trip, twelve miles off Fort Pierce, Florida.
A Coast Guard plane from Clearwater spotted them at about eight thirty in the morning.
A Hercules can circle for hours, keeping its camera on survivors.
A sportfishing boat pulled up beside the hull.
One by one, the men climbed off the hull and onto the boat.
outcome: Both missing men were rescued, and a Coast Guard boat met them at sea.
title: Clinging to a flipped boat 12 miles out
description:
A Coast Guard HC-130 Hercules aircrew from Air Station Clearwater found two men, missing from a weekend fishing trip, clinging to the hull of their capsized boat 12 miles off Fort Pierce, Florida, May 5, 2014.
